correctness.rationale: PASS. Read frozen RESULT.md and verification.py. Full-branch transfer P h=a h(ax)+(1−a)h(1−(1−a)x) has simple isolated stationary eigenvalue on BV, analytic twisted eigenvalue ρ(t) near t=0. Differentiating through third order solves zero-mean polynomial h1,h2,h3 because 1−[a^(j+1)+(−1)^j(1−a)^(j+1)] never vanishes for j≥1 and 0<a<1. Independent SymPy substitution checked all three polynomial recurrence residuals vanish identically and yields K2=a/[12(1−a)], K3=−a/[24(1−a)²], K4=a[19+6a(1−a)]/[720(1−a)³]. Also exact rational checks verified G²=3/[a(1−a)], H=6/5+(19/15)G² at four a. Spectral gap, not finite orbit counts, justifies limits and cumulant derivative interchange; symmetric a=1/2 is included but previously known.
